assumptions: Store path pinned to ~/.todo.json (not cwd-relative) — resolves discovered-seed #1; rationale recorded in domain-model.md Bounded Context section.
Corrupted-store recovery policy: hard-fail with a clear stderr message and non-zero exit, never auto-overwrite — resolves discovered-seed #2, per orient's recommendation.
Exit-code / stream convention pinned: stdout + exit 0 on success, stderr + exit 1 on any error — resolves discovered-seed #3.
1-based display/index convention pinned, with array-position identity re-derived fresh on every command (no persisted item id) — resolves discovered-seed #4.
Entry-point wiring: package.json with a `bin` field (`todo`) plus direct `node bin/todo.js` invocation, no CLI-parsing dependency — resolves discovered-seed #5.

Lens=standard applied per the order payload: full domain-model + contracts/ + integration.md + synthesis S-02/S-03 generated, even though the deliverable is a single-package CLI with no monorepo apps/packages split (package field on tasks uses 'cli' as the single package name).

Test Surface Oracle set to `process` on every derived row (non-UI CLI deliverable) per references/test-surface.md — evaluator should spawn the CLI as a subprocess and assert exit code + stdout/stderr, never drive a browser.

`done <n>` treated as idempotent (marking an already-done item done again succeeds, does not error) — a product decision not stated in the pitch, recorded as UC-CompleteTodo INV-06 and RULE in ux-behavior.md.
